glossary.definition: (1) "Accommodations" means housing, daily meal preparation, laundry, housekeeping, arranging for transportation, social and recreational activities, maintenance, security, and other services that do not constitute personal care services or skilled nursing care.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (2) "ADAMHS board" means a board of alcohol, drug addiction, and mental health services.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (3) "Adult" means a person who is eighteen years of age or older, other than a person described in division (A)(4) of this section who is between eighteen and twenty-one years of age.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (4) "Child" means a person who is under eighteen years of age or a person with a mental disability who is under twenty-one years of age.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (5) "Operator" means the person or persons, firm, partnership, agency, governing body, association, corporation, or other entity that is responsible for the administration and management of a residential facility and that is the applicant for a residential facility license.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: "Personal care services" does not include "skilled nursing care" as defined in section 3721.01 of the Revised Code. A facility need not provide more than one of the services listed in division (A)(6) of this section to be considered to be providing personal care services.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (7) "Room and board" means the provision of sleeping and living space, meals or meal preparation, laundry services, housekeeping services, or any combination thereof.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 5119.341 to 5119.344 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 5119.34 - Inspecting and licensing of residential facilities.

glossary.definition: (8) "Residential state supplement program" means the program established under section 5119.41 of the Revised Code.
